tagline: Four FC games, one club. Finally signed a defender.

dirty8ightt.bio: Runs the CPU and the midfield: 17 assists in the last 20, the most in the squad. The MOTM voters haven't noticed yet.

mo_nm.bio: 23 goals in the last 20 and seven straight games on the scoresheet. Still the first to volunteer for goal when we're short.

EnEsC-37.bio: Splits it right down the middle: 13 goals and 13 assists in the last 20. Won 10 of them too.

Pakst-.bio: The scope needs cleaning: no goal in 7 games. Leads the squad in tackles lately though, 28 in the last 20.

x-LadruM-x.bio: The club's first real centre-back has 5 MOTM in the last 20, more than anyone. Chipped in 7 goals on top.

RUPPADOR.bio: Scored on debut and hasn't really stopped: 9 goals in 11 games, and only 2 of them lost.

Hamza__075.bio: 4 games, 4 goals, 4 wins. Small sample, perfect record.

Its-1-Shot-Wisk.bio: Two games, two wins, one MOTM and an 8.4 average. The name promises one shot; hasn't needed it yet.

HachMonsterrr.bio: Two games, two wins. The stats sheet is still warming up.
